description:
About the Role

Join an early-stage fintech team building reliable trading infrastructure and an AI-supported trading platform. You will develop core systems that help make sophisticated trading simpler and more accessible.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain order handling systems.

  • Develop risk rules and controls for trading workflows.

  • Design and build reliable ledger systems.

  • Scale performance-sensitive systems under production load.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 8 years of systems engineering experience, with strong software fundamentals.

  • Proficiency in Rust or strong C++ skills; experience with both is valuable.

  • Experience developing low-latency, correctness-critical systems, such as in trading, payments, exchanges, or related fields.

  • Experience building or working with order management, risk, or ledger systems is a plus.

  • Background in trading, financial markets, crypto, stocks, or fintech is beneficial.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $100,000 to $250,000 annually. Meaningful equity is offered. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

Fully remote. Primary location: Bucharest, Romania.
